Markdown strips a code span's padding space from each side, as markdown-it does (rich-unfiled-791c.3kln)

A code span whose text starts and ends with a space and is not all
whitespace, as Python's str.strip reads it, loses one space from each end:
'a ` b ` c' draws 'a b c'. '`  `' is kept whole, and a no-break space or a
tab pads nothing. Pinned against Rich 15 (markdown-it-py 4.2.0).

Markdown cuts an ATX heading's closing #s, as markdown-it does (rich-unfiled-791c.4op8) (#444)

* Markdown cuts an ATX heading's closing #s, as markdown-it does (rich-unfiled-791c.4op8)

A run of # at the end of a heading line, spaces and tabs after it allowed,
is cut when a space or tab comes before it: '# x #' draws 'x', '# x#' keeps
its '#', and '# #' is an empty heading. Pinned against Rich 15.

* Markdown heading test: the closing-run comment states both conditions, in real characters (rich-unfiled-791c.4op8)
